risks.proof: A clip or photo of the camera powered on showing live view and a shutter count screen (via menu or EOSInfo).
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / body-only worst case

risks.risk: Claimed accessories (2 batteries, charger, Godox trigger) may not actually accompany the sale.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the camera together with the two batteries, the charger, and the Godox trigger, ideally with the trigger's model name visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, no accessories

risks.risk: Seller's condition statement is cut off, possibly hiding a defect (e.g., shutter count, sensor dust, dented mount) that was meant to be disclosed.
risks.proof: Full, uncut condition text from seller, plus close-up photos of the lens mount, sensor, and LCD screen for scratches/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case for cosmetic/functional condition

risks.risk: No lens is included, so buyer needs to budget separately for one.
risks.proof: Confirmed by photos showing body cap only; no lens photo provided.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, showing live view on the LCD and the shutter count via Canon menu.
Photo of the camera together with the 2 batteries, charger, and Godox trigger for verification.
The complete, uncut condition description from the seller.
Close-up photos of the sensor (with mirror up) and the lens mount for scratches, fungus, or dust.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Canon EOS 5D Mark III body (no lens) from the visible lettering in photos 0 and 2, but working condition is unverified (blank LCD, no power-on proof) and the claimed accessories are not shown, so it must be priced at worst case as a body-only unit matching the one directly comparable listing.
